author: zicuri
body:
Hello, some of the players on Horizon have decided to make a map that is Capture The Flag. It is a 6-8 player map that will hopefully be featured in the next tournament or even in the public rotations. The map will be first to 3 captures. We enjoyed making this map and hope everyone likes it! Huge shout out to {tag=ae5c1e91745b4a6fa33711484ede6957} for whitelisting all of us on his server in short notice. The map did not take very long to build (3-4 hours) so if things are too plain or there is something that needs or should be added please just let us know! Also, If you look on the imgur you can see that red’s drop down is a bit shorter, reason it looks like that is because on the plot right next to it is our 5CP version we did not want to show that until it was done.

Spawn Kit: Leather Helmet, Leather Chestplate with projectal protection I, Iron pants, Leather boots, Stone sword, Bow with 16 arrows and Gapple

Map Creators: {tag=004e817d35fa47aeac7e4f37d70ed9ba} & {tag=4d10e1b13fcc4537a1620cca6754da2d}

Helpers: {tag=8fb7e4dcb57540dbacd8754b1ba81aa5}, {tag=fa83f6f2ef214dc3b11a2b21d16e2b8c},{tag=04b454b5686f44649c6f67c1df698ec3}, {tag=70d2e97acd93474c83d485233621b453}

Server?: Clijmart’s build server

Gamemode?: Capture The Flag (Tournament)

XML: Done by {tag=c2a4c847653e482ab62ed7f8b64330cb} thank you so much!

IMGUR: http://imgur.com/a/jMb92
